unresolved_semantics: STORY037 opens with eight controlled party members (001-007 and 009) plus the conditional 咕嚕 008 (EVEF 有才產生 record 10, fielded only when the carry holds the member), three Enemy033 and eight Enemy035 units. The shared assembler uses the STORY endpoints and generated actor templates for these 20 units.

STORY037's five random-position beats insert the guardians as PlayLoop units: actSetRandomPos fills five slots, each actInsertObjectRandomPos installs an Enemy067 gem (guard067_n, slot + (0,32)) and an Enemy066 guardian (guard066_n, on the slot) in slot order, so SID_ENEMY067/066 serial n is slot n-1 (0x451d0f / 0x450f2c / 0x44fad0, static-derived). The native shuffle (slot i swaps with slot (i+2) mod 5 on each odd 0x458c10 draw) is not reproduced: the table order is used (provisional). STORY037 sets all ten undead; both rows refresh to max HP 1 (hit_point -10000), so they revive at 1 HP.

The gems (PLAYERS 67, pmMagicAttack 0x870000 = pmALL|0x800000, no_attack) take magic and specials only: 0x40f5d0 keeps a pmALL occupant in every player range except the weapon ranges built with flag 1 (0x409090 callers), which drop 0x800000 occupants; the AI target scan 0x40bb80 never picks a pmALL unit. WINFAIL037's pmPlayerEnemy / pmMagicAttack swaps turn a gem off and on. A gem has no AI declarations and nothing it can target, so it waits (remake reading of the empty native scan).

actPlayerJobUpProcess merges the source template 017 (jobEvilMonster 邪獸, the row PLAYERS 008 job_up_code 816 resolves to through global.obs obj_Data7) into the registered 咕嚕 slot like the town job-up (actor id 008 stays the rules key, job_up_target_actor_id / job_up_history record 017, native 0x80000000 flag) so the campaign carry replays the form in later battles; current HP/MP are kept and clamped to the new maxima (0x4348f0 / 0x407ec0 / 0x448840 write no vitals). This is consumed only when the event is armed; a member whose row declares job_up 0 is a no-op like 0x4348f0; missing target templates fail explicitly.

The level-37 token conditions and transformation action are static-derived from 0x450840 / 0x4348f0 and have focused interpreter coverage; this does not prove native scheduler, global slot-registration, RNG or frame-timing equivalence.
